messages:
sam: FYI client-acme asked to extend their SIEM export retention to 12 months and have delivery via partner. need to confirm secure unwrap + who owns RBAC.
trisha: big picture: any retention >90d is exception process. we need ticket with business justification + legal signoff. also: what's the export surface? full raw logs or filtered events?
sam: it's filtered events (auth + app errors). i'll add a data-classification map.
alex: for unwrap i recommend a centralized KMS-proxy that holds Decrypt perms. flow: exporter -> kms-proxy (authn) -> proxy decrypts and returns time-limited artifact URL. avoids putting CMK on export hosts.
trisha: agree. policy notes: kms:Decrypt only for `siem-exporter` role, never to end-users. consumers get short-lived presigned URLs. include `export_reason`, `ticket_id`, `approved_by` in every audit record.
sam: can infra create an `siem-exporter` role + an `siem-downloader` service account? who approves?
infrastructure-bot: infra-bot: created RFC-4567 placeholder ticket for role + proxy design. assign to alex + trisha.
trisha: reviewers: security + compliance. compliance-bot will require CMK rotation policy and partner notice windows. compliance-bot: please provide required rotation notice period.
compliance-bot: ComplianceBot: For partner exports affecting decrypt availability, provide 30-day advance notice before rotating CMKs. Exports must include a key-version header for provenance.
alex: noted. also recommend rate-limits on the proxy (100 requests/min per tenant) and per-request size limits.
sam: what about RBAC for requesting retention extension? ops should not be able to grant. team owners + security + legal need to approve via ticket.
trisha: add a checklist to the ticket: data map, legal contact, justification, deletion verification plan, monitoring dashboard for export counts, and automated audit tagging.
alex: i'll draft Terraform modules: IAM role for siem-exporter, IAM policy with kms:Decrypt on CMK ARN, and a TLS-authenticated kms-proxy service. sample policy snippet in the ticket.
sam: i'll create ticket now with template: - requester: client-acme - retention: 12 months - data-scope: filtered-auth-and-errors - owner: sam - unwrap: kms-proxy - compliance-contact: @trisha - proposed-cmk: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/ACME
trisha: once ticket is up i'll start review. target: approval in 48h, infra provision next week. :lock:
